authority.approval_basis: Direct owner instruction approving the recommended bounded preview and requiring later tracks to continue.

scope: machine-readable release train and track graph
excluded_claims: clinical, dispatch, planning, causal or operational fitness
publication_conditions: tag v0.2.0 resolves to the exact source revision
GitHub release is marked as a prerelease and states all exclusions

later_track_policy.requirement: All pre-existing tracks retain their status, maturity target, release target and acceptance criteria.

rollback_and_withdrawal: withdraw or replace affected assets when checksum or attestation verification fails
publish a correction or security notice for material defects
retain the tag and provenance record when withdrawing support so history remains auditable
